Renatus paused to regain his footing, a mistake that his opponent quickly capitalized on.

"You must sustain your balance at all times. You can't parry or dodge when you can't even stand right." said the opponent. He sighed and looked at Oblitus. "He is hopeless and not worthy of that armor."

"I don't care about your opinion, Shozo. I woke you to train him." Oblitus' words shook the Nusquam. Both he and Renatus were irritated by this sword master, but he was the best in the collection.

Shozo faced Renatus, "Again!"

Renatus had enough. As Shozo advanced, he sheathed both swords. When Shozo's sword struck the Bleeding Aegis, it snapped like a twig. Renatus grabbed Shozo's neck and threw him across the arena Oblitus created in the Nusquam.

Shozo looked at Oblitus in horror. "Why dodge when he is unstoppable!?"

"Because he doesn't have that luxury with his swords out." Oblitus looked at Renatus. "Your Defensive State isn't the purpose of this training. If I wanted to practice that, I'd just launch light arrows at you with the Solar Bow." *It is crucial for him to complete this training.* Oblitus thought. *While the Ice Brain was necessary to have Renatus, it's more taxing on my god power to sustain it in the Nusquam. I need a representative on Gaea until I get use to the Ice Brain's upkeep. Shozo is truly the best sword master in my collection, but he will need more than that.*

Oblitus threw a new sword at Shozo. "Use this. And Renatus, if you break that, you will pay for it."

Renatus drew both swords and readied himself. Though the training is tough, mastering the Offensive State was necessary to win a fight in the Bleeding Aegis.
